During [[T'Charek Haathi]]'s stint as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], she served under a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''commanding officer'''. She would constantly refer to him as "Admiral [[Nerf/Legends|Nerf]]" in an effort to get under his skin.<ref name="Ship Jackers" />
